generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The tenderer shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and including all other applicable taxes, levies, duties etc as per the latest GOK & GOI prevailing rules.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tender document is part and parcel of agreement.
The contractor shall follow minimum wages act and other statutory acts and its amendments.

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor, civil/similar nature of work to an extent of value not less than of Rs 16,93,202.00 (Excluding GST) in any one year in the last five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The work done certificate issued from state / central Government / Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre shall be furnished. (Weightage of 10% per year will be given to the cost of completed works of previous years to bring them to the price level of present financial year)
Any reputed individual/company registered KPWD Class-III and above contractor is eligible to apply and certificate issued in this regard shall be uploaded.

The tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.33.87 lakhs in the last five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant shall be furnished. (Weightage of 10% per year will be given to the financial turnover of previous years to bring them to the price level of present financial year i.e., 2026-27)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing painting along with Sand blasting, rectification works to CWPH Unit-1 & 2 at BTPS

itemList.description: Cleaning gates / hoists / embedded parts to expose fresh metal surface for repainting by sand blasting method as per specifications including cost of all materials, labour, machinery, scaffolding, applying a coat of rust inhibitive compound with all other ancillary operations complete.

Providng and applying two coats of Two component, high build, 100% solid content, low VOC., polycyclin aromatic hydro carbon based, Pot life - 2 hours @ 72 deg.F, Tack free - 4.6 hrs, DFE percent 80 - 120 microns (dry) coal tar epoxy coating with Coal tar.

Providing and fixing stainless steel of 304 grade mesh of 10x10mm opening with 2mm diametre crimped wire to the steel frame using bolts and flats (excluding the cost of bolts and flats) including the cost of all Materials, Labours, Machineries, loading, unloading, other incidental charges and complete as directed by Engineer in charge with all lead and lifts.

Providing and fixing Structural Steel work riveted, bolted or welded in built up sections, trusses and framed work, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer all complete including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Rectification of forebay crane track alignment by removing the warped rails and replacement of new rails by ensuring proper straightness and cross-level, repositioning & leveling the rails using jacks and verifying the final alignment to ensure smooth and safe operation of the crane including cost of all Materials (exculding cost of rail), welding, fitting, Labours, aligning, Machineries, loading, unloading, other incidental charges and complete as directed by Engineer in charge with all lead and lifts.
Demolishing R.C.C. work manually/ by mechanical means including stacking of steel bars and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and laying in position Reinforced cement concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necesary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all otherappurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement to be paid separately) M25 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates including form work.

Providing TMT steel reinforcement for RCC works including straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, placing in position, lapping and or welding wherever required, tying with binding wire and anchoring to the adjoining members wherever necessary complete as per design( laps, hooks and wastage shall not be meadured and paid) cost of materials, labours, HOM of machinary complete as per specification,

Providing, fabricating & supplying of stainless steel Bolts and Nuts with all leads and lifts etc., including cost of materials, labour, transportation etc. complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.
